questions.stem: A 33-year-old male met with a road traffic accident. There is persistent watery discharge mixed with blood from his nose for 3 days which cannot be sniffed back. Which of the following should not be done in this condition?
questions.stemHtml: A 33-year-old male met with a road traffic accident. There is persistent watery discharge mixed with blood from his nose for 3 days which cannot be sniffed back. Which of the following should not be done in this condition?

options.label: B
options.text: Plan surgical treatment with functional endoscopic sinus surgery

options.label: C
options.text: Bed rest and avoiding strenuous activity
